Metadata.title: Guild Bazaar — platform for re-enactors, LARP and cosplay
Metadata.description: A platform connecting guilds, associations, artisans and vendors. Community and marketplace for historical re-enactment, LARP and cosplay.

Hero.title: One place for <highlight>re-enactors,</highlight> LARPers and cosplayers
Hero.subtitle: Guild Bazaar connects historical and fantasy communities — guilds, associations, artisans and vendors in one place.

Features.title: Everything the community needs
Features.subtitle: Guild Bazaar brings together everyone in the re-enactment scene — from newcomers to veterans.

associations.title: Guilds and associations
associations.description: Create a profile for your guild or association, share its history and specialization, and recruit new members.

marketplace.title: Artisan marketplace
marketplace.description: List products or services — armour, costumes, props, weaving and all kinds of craft.

search.title: Advanced search
search.description: Filter listings and guilds by era, location, specialization and availability.

vendor.title: Vendor profile
vendor.description: Manage your listings, business description and appear on event vendor lists.

Platform.title: What Guild Bazaar looks like
Platform.subtitle: Browse key views of the platform — from browsing listings to panels for vendors and guilds.

offers.title: Listings and craft
offers.description: Browse offers for armour, costumes and craft from across Poland.
offers.alt: Artisan listings overview on Guild Bazaar

associations.alt: List of historical guilds and associations
